decisions.reason: The candidate already has a message-18 MODIFY directly establishing the user-funded and PPP scenarios and their scope; the debt-modeling scope expansion requires no additional candidate change.
Expanding debt modeling to the user-funded and PPP cases does not necessarily alter the integrated statement structure or financial-engine basis.
The debt-modeling scope change does not modify the capex estimate, midpoint assumption basis, or capex scope.
The candidate's general assumption-documentation policy already applies independently; the debt-modeling scope expansion does not necessarily change its state.
The debt-modeling scope expansion does not change the availability or assumption source of operating-expenditure figures.
The source Event does not change the revenue streams, pricing assumptions, documentation rule, or revenue-modeling scope.
The debt-modeling scope change does not alter source-data verification, reference-source selection, or the demand analysis's directional role.
The candidate's CAD currency and 2026 price-base requirements remain valid unchanged.
The financing scope expansion does not change the eight-site count or the policy for modeling unavailable site-level information.
The source Event does not modify formula correctness, worksheet-link behavior, or model-audit scope.
